defect: The change flipped the signs in NURBS_HCurl2DFiniteElement::CalcCurlShape, so the 2D curl became du_x/dy - du_y/dx instead of du_y/dx - du_x/dy.
reason: The x-component term uses the y-derivative and must carry the minus sign; the fix restores exactly the signs this change removed.

defect: The new interior-face length scale h averages edge-length/reference ratios (0.5*(A_perp_1/A_ref_1 + A_perp_2/A_ref_2)) using edge lengths rather than perpendicular element heights, which is wrong for non-rectangular or non-uniform LOR elements.
reason: The same-day Bugfix replaces exactly these added A_perp/h lines with an area-based perpendicular distance in the sum-over-sum form; the A_ref change in the fix is only an equivalent simplification.

defect: The fix adapts QEvalVGF3D to a later change of the kernels::internal 3D API (DeviceCube/ConstDeviceMatrix arguments).
reason: At c4e721c kernels::internal still provided the raw-array 3D LoadX/EvalX/PullEval overloads, so the code was correct when written; the signatures changed in later commits (6356fad, e39a2a4).

defect: The fix lowers the default quadrature order for VectorFEBoundaryFluxLFIntegrator without a coefficient from 2p-1 to p-1.
reason: Order 2p-1 still integrates the degree-p integrand exactly, so the change only over-integrates; the fix is an efficiency/accuracy tuning, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix extends the unit test to a real NC mesh using the conforming prolongation and tightens the tolerances.
reason: This is a test change; the original test was valid for the conforming mesh it actually used.

defect: The fix only rewraps long MPI_Allreduce lines.
reason: Pure style fix.

defect: The fix renames the inner loop variable c that shadowed the reshaped coefficient view c, removing a shadow warning.
reason: Inside the loop the int c is meant, and c(q,e) after the loop refers to the view, so behaviour was correct; only a compiler warning was fixed.

defect: The new UpdateVertices numbers ghost vertices from 0 (NGhostVertices++), so their vert_index values collide with owned vertex indices, and the vertex_nodeId map built over NVertices+NGhostVertices gets owned entries overwritten by ghost nodes.
reason: The fix moves the vertex_nodeId construction, which this change added, ahead of ghost numbering and sizes it to NVertices only; the overlap can be seen in the diff.

defect: The fix renames the members u/du to tmp_u/tmp_du so the calcBasis parameter u no longer shadows them.
reason: Shadowing only causes a warning, not wrong behaviour; this is a cleanup.

defect: The fix reformats the new Multigrid constructor and moves the GeometricMultigrid constructor inline into the header.
reason: This is a style fix; the real operators.Last() bug in this change was repaired by a different commit (a19b34b).

defect: The fix moves the GeometricMultigrid constructor definition inline into the header.
reason: Style/refactor only; no behaviour change.

defect: x_out_loc/x_loc are now allocated with GetVSize() and then re-pointed with SetData(x_out.GetData()), which leaks the owned buffer; in TMOPDescentNewtonSolver the min det(J) loop also reads x_loc before any values are written to it.
reason: The fix replaces the added SetData calls with copies and flags the uninitialized x_loc; both are lines this change introduced.

defect: The fix re-indents from 4 to 3 spaces and adds comments.
reason: Pure style fix; the metric-9 formulas are unchanged by it.

defect: The fix re-indents the class declarations, renames tauptr to tau0 and adds documentation comments.
reason: Style/refactor only.

defect: The fix makes GetElementValues(idx, ip_num, values) compute the offset directly instead of going through a temporary element view.
reason: The original version returns correct values (the temporary only references the global data), so this is a performance improvement.

defect: The added node placement uses GetElementDofs (scalar dofs) with SetSubVector on sdim*ndof point values and transposes under the wrong ordering condition, so high-order simplex Nodes are written to the wrong entries.
reason: The fix switches to GetElementVDofs and inverts the ordering condition in these added lines; the TODO comment in the change itself names the dof/vdof size mismatch.

defect: The fix replaces a WIP test that loads a hard-coded user path with a real test over repository meshes.
reason: This is a test change.

defect: rotateSimplex uses an assignment (type = apf::Mesh::TET) instead of a comparison in the else-if, so any non-triangle type is treated as a tet and type is overwritten.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line to ==.

defect: The fix adds support for node ordering (ordering arguments and byNODES checks) to DiscreteAdaptTC and the adaptivity evaluator.
reason: This is a feature extension; the change only renamed adapt_lim_eval to adapt_eval.

defect: The fix ('Try to fix ex10 bug') removes the duplicate state.SetSize calls in NewmarkSolver::Init and GeneralizedAlpha2Solver::Init and adds GetStateSize to SecondOrderODESolver.
reason: The removed calls only reset the state twice, which looks harmless, and the actual ex10 failure cannot be pinned to a line of this change.

defect: The fix moves an opening brace to its own line.
reason: Pure style fix.

defect: The new header uses the include guard MFEM_DREFMAT_OP, which pderefmat_op.hpp (added in the same commit) also uses, so whichever is included second is silently skipped.
reason: The fix renames the guard to MFEM_DEREFMAT_OP; the collision only shows when the other header is compared.

defect: HypreAMS::Init and MakeGradientAndInterpolation now take sdim/vdim from FEColl()->GetVDim(dim), which returns 0 for ND/RT trace collections (no element of dimension dim), breaking AMS for trace spaces.
reason: The fix 'Fix AMS for trace FE spaces' computes vdim with dim-1 for trace spaces and uses max(sdim, vdim); seeing it requires FiniteElementCollection::GetVDim.

defect: The fix replaces problem.x_lo/x_hi in an MFEM_ASSERT with the GetBoundsVec_Lo/Hi accessors.
reason: At c7f41cd these pointers were public members of OptimizationProblem; the debug build broke only after later commit 998b58e hid them.

defect: The new b0.Update()/b1.Update() calls drop the MakeRef link of the linear forms to the rhs blocks, and a00.Update() sits after the break, so after an early Newton exit the next outer iteration assembles a00 on top of the old matrix.
reason: The fix removes the b0/b1 Update calls and moves a00.Update() before the break check, exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The fix corrects the wording of a comment.
reason: Documentation only.

defect: dmuz is allocated with size 3 and then assigned from the temporaries returned by grad_mu0/grad_mu1; Vector's move assignment does not free the old buffer, so every assignment leaks memory.
reason: The fix adds dmuz.Destroy() before each of these added assignments; seeing the leak requires Vector::operator=(Vector&&) in vector.cpp.

defect: The fix only adds parentheses around the condition of a ternary operator.
reason: == already binds tighter than ?:, so the code is unchanged; this was a style tweak while chasing a Travis issue.

defect: The fix reworks the shared-memory sizes, sets the thread count to 32, caches element coordinates and adds new kernel instantiations.
reason: The change's nThreads = MAX(2*MD1,4) is a valid compile-time bound; the later fix is a broad rework, not a repair of a defect in these lines.

defect: For byVDIM spaces the new ProjectQuadratureDiscCoefficient reorders the element result into interleaved order before SetSubVector, but element vdofs are always listed component by component, so the values land in the wrong dofs.
reason: The fix removes the reordering branch that this change added; it needs the GetElementVDofs ordering convention to see.

defect: The parallel ParaviewDataCollection constructor creates the output directory and opens and writes the .pvd file at construction time, before the prefix path or other settings can be applied.
reason: The fix 'Fix ParaViewDataCollection constructor in parallel' deletes exactly this block that this change added; seeing why requires knowing that SetPrefixPath is called later and that Save also opens the file.

defect: The fix replaces trailing commas (comma operator) with semicolons in the constructors.
reason: The comma-operator form compiles and behaves the same; this is a style fix.

defect: The fix merges a two-line comment into one.
reason: Style only.

defect: The rewrite contains '#ifdef MFEM_USE_CEEDit = mymap.begin();', which disables the whole body; it also erases with an undeclared iterator 'it' and calls CeedBasisDestroy on restrictions.
reason: The fix 'Fix typos' repairs exactly these added lines.

defect: The fix replaces deprecated Mesh constructors with MakeCartesian2D/3D in the unit test.
reason: This is a test/deprecation change.

defect: The new HIP branch of SortColumnIndices calls rocsparse functions with an undeclared handle/descrA and assigns the sorted values to an undeclared a_sorted, so it does not compile and never writes the sorted values back to A.
reason: The fix rewrites these added lines with hipsparse calls, a created descriptor and A.CopyFrom.

defect: The destructor uses 'delete k' on k, which is allocated with new Vector[s], so it is undefined behaviour (non-array delete of an array).
reason: The fix changes the added line to 'delete [] k'; the allocation is in ode.cpp.

defect: The fix removes @param with_coeff from the doc comments after the parameter was removed.
reason: Documentation only.

defect: In the MSVC branch, MFEM_DISABLE_WARNING_DEPRECATED expands to DISABLE_WARNING(4996), a macro that this change renamed away, so every use fails to compile with MSVC.
reason: The fix changes this renamed line to MFEM_DISABLE_WARNING(4996).

defect: The fix moves the #ifdef inside the if (parallel) block so that the parallel member is used in serial builds, silencing an unused-variable warning.
reason: Behaviour is identical in serial and parallel builds; only a warning was fixed.
